_comment: Seat model map (loop/model-tiering, 2026-10-16; port of drivia-consulting 888ba2b13). build.mjs stamps this onto template.mjs as const SEAT_MODELS. A seat is the label prefix before the first ':' (e.g. acceptance:A:yap24-01 -> acceptance). Seats not listed run exactly as written in the template (opus). Listed seats run on the named smaller model with SMALL_SEAT_CONTRACT appended; agentR re-runs the SAME prompt on 'escalate' when the small seat returns NEEDS_OPUS, returns a result missing a 'require' field, or returns null twice. opusOnly is enforced by build.mjs: a builder, fixer, lander, reviewer or verdict seat can never be mapped down. Kill switch: set enabled to false here, or launch with args {seatModels:false}.
